notes.title: Happy 2nd birthday, Recollection! Here's 2 special presents!
notes.notes:
It's been exactly two years since the release of Recollection, so here's two special surprises to celebrate this anniversay:
1. I'm permanently reducing the price for the game from 4.99 to 1.99 $/€ (or your regional equivalent)!
2. The fully arranged soundtrack for the game is now available here on Steam and over on [url=https://erkberg.bandcamp.com/album/recollection-ost]Bandcamp[/url]. More streaming services like Spotify will follow soon!

Thanks to everyone for checking out my little game, it means a lot <3

Cheers,
Erkberg

notes.title: The “Bird+” Update Is Here
notes.notes:
Recollection just got updated to v1.0.692, addressing issues some players had since the release of the game:
- The bird interaction now shows a little hint of what to do after some time
- The graphic used for the watch tutorial got updated to make it more clear
- The moon is now a bit easier to spot
- The music is less loud towards the end of the game for a better overall audio balance
- Fixed the Czech translation of the word "On"
- The demo also got updated, now playing a few more instruments when getting to the end

Cheers,
Erkberg

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
The Recollection demo has just been updated to version 0.8.589, bringing it more in line with the upcoming release by adding many improvements and bug fixes.

Highlights of this update include:
- a refined mechanic for the fragile mountain interaction
- new music for fragile mode
- a reworked menu, including many new settings, especially for texts and visuals, but also a difficulty setting for fragile mode
- ingame tutorials, updated fonts, reworked credits, and much more!

I'm very excited to release the full version of the game in April '23! Until then, I'll do my best to smooth out some remaining rough edges, fix as many bugs as humanly possible and add support for more languages.

Cheers,
Erkberg

notes.title: Demo Update & New Release Date
notes.notes:
The Recollection demo has just been updated to version 0.5.295, including many small improvements and bugfixes.

Here's the full changelog:
[list]
[*] updated controls and added a new controls menu
[*] made the game's visuals brighter
[*] added UI sounds
[*] added a warning text for fragile mode
[*] added a sound while finding an object
[*] the help line for finding objects now appears a bit faster and the moon is a bit more visible to help at the start of a new game
[*] the fragile mode glitch has been updated and received several fixes
[*] the player character now animates slower when moving slower and transitions smoother when entering an object
[*] the speed transition when using the slow cursor has been smoothed
[*] music transitions have been fixed and improved
[*] mountain visuals have been improved
[/list]

Along with this comes the announcement that the release of the full version has been postponed to early 2023. I want to make this game as enjoyable, polished and awesome as possible, and it just needs a little more time to get there :)

Hope you enjoy this update!
Cheers,
Erkberg

notes.title: Bugfixes and improvements for the demo
notes.notes:
The Recollection demo has just received a small update containing several bugfixes and improvements.
Here's the full changelog:
- added a little help line that appears after some time and points towards objects, to help when objects are not found
- fixed a bug that could result in fragile mode glitches becoming faster and crashing the game
- adjusted continue and new game menu header texts to make them more clear
- fixed a bug that highlighted neighbor stars that are already connected and make highlights appear a bit more often
- when using a gamepad, the slow cursor tutorial is now shown at the start of every interaction
- fixed an audio bug for the moon in fragile mode and decreased moon vibration (it was a bit much)

Hope you enjoy these little improvements!

Cheers,
Erkberg

notes.title: UI update for the demo!

notes.title: Recollection Demo for Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
Recollection is part of the Steam Next Fest!
That means there is now a free demo available for you to try out.
It has a playtime of around 5-10 minutes and contains three out of the 11+ objects from the full version for you to discover and experience, as well as a (quite subtle) sneak peek for the second game mode.
[previewyoutube=IUwcoWQxzvE;full][/previewyoutube]
I hope you enjoy playing as much as I do creating it. :)
Let me know how you like it in the comments, on the Steam forums and on social media. And thank you so much for trying out my little indie game, it really means a lot to me!

Cheers,
Erkberg
